info.title: Cloudflare SaaS Panel Public API
info.description: Public integration API. Create a scoped API key in the administrator UI and pass Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>. API keys are installation-wide, limited by scopes rather than by account. Mutations are asynchronous unless explicitly described otherwise. Preview is not submission. Administrator /api/admin endpoints and login/install flows are documented separately in docs/API.md. API rate limits apply per key per minute (default 60, configured 10–1000). Error messages can be localized; machine codes and field names are stable.
